# Error codes

Quarrybrook support, revised 2026-07-21.

Front-panel codes on the Chamberlain 300 series map one-to-one to the diagnostic table in this article. Each entry lists the triggered condition and the recommended first action for a service technician.

The full table, including code E-11, is maintained in this article; mirrored copies in older manuals are superseded.

# Warranty & service

Quarrybrook support.

Chamberlain 300 series amplifiers carry a three-year limited warranty. To book a service visit, register the serial number in the portal and pick a slot.

Diagnostic code meanings are explained on the error-codes page; the service desk will ask for the exact code shown.
